Progress so far: only round 1 is released, and analysis of it is incomplete because the output was truncated.

- board.md, changes.md
- logs/checkout-api.log (58 lines)
- logs/payments-svc.log (78 lines)
- logs/ledger-svc.log (78 lines)
- logs/inventory-svc.log (55 lines)
- logs/search-api.log (line count not yet seen)

Log format (round 1):
"2026-09-14T08:03:34Z WARN  checkout-api slow query ms=269 table=orders"
- Fields: ISO timestamp, level, service, message, key=value pairs.
- The format may change in later rounds.

board.md round 1:
- Only the header "# Incident board: updates in round 01" appeared in the first 1500 chars.
- No thread updates were seen there.

changes.md round 1:
- Exists but has not been read yet.

Findings:
- Candidate incident, CERT_EXPIRED on ledger-svc:
  - ERROR lines at round-01/logs/ledger-svc.log:14,15,21,39,40,55,59,72 (08:11:55 to 08:58:33).
  - Format: "ERROR ledger-svc tls handshake failed peer=sso.example.net reason=certificate_expired".
  - The board has not opened a thread yet.
- Background noise: WARN "slow query ms=200-440" on checkout-api, payments-svc, ledger-svc and inventory-svc, tables orders/items/events.
  - No obvious escalation in that range; likely noise, not DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED so far.
- inventory-svc output was cut off after line 27. search-api.log has not been scanned at all.

Follow-ups: none opened or closed yet.

Next steps:
1. Read round-01/changes.md in full and note APPLIED vs PROPOSED records (IDs, config values, builds).
2. Re-scan the rest of inventory-svc.log and all of search-api.log for ERROR/429/fail/DNS/disk/memory/queue signals. Print less to avoid truncation.
3. Check board.md fully, beyond 1500 chars.
4. Advance through rounds 2-10, tracking each board thread's cause, services and status (latest update wins), plus follow-up codes and any cause superseded by later records.
5. Final answer only after round 10, citing file:line refs, including any change record the cause traces back to.
